ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the left vertical axis represents rainfall, the bar chart shows one rainfall process, the maximum rainfall appears in an earlier period, and an arrow marks “maximum rainfall.” The right vertical axis represents river discharge, the line graph represents the discharge process, the flood peak discharge appears in a later period after the rainfall peak, and an arrow marks “flood peak discharge.” Above the two, “time interval” is labeled, indicating the lag time between the rainfall peak and the discharge peak. Then reason: The question states that under the same rainfall conditions, if the time interval between the rainfall peak and the discharge peak shortens, then the reason should not be a change in rainfall itself, but rather a decline in the watershed’s regulation, storage, and flood-retarding capacity. Wetlands have the functions of conserving water sources, storing water and retarding floods, and delaying the entry of surface runoff into river channels. If a large amount of upstream wetlands are destroyed, rainwater will form runoff more quickly and flow into the river, causing the flood peak to arrive earlier, and therefore the time interval shortens.

method.method_draft: 先读图：图中左侧柱状降雨过程有“最大雨量”峰值，右侧河流流量曲线在其后才出现“洪峰流量”，两峰之间标出“时距”，表示降雨峰到流量峰的滞后时间。再读题：题设强调“相同降雨状态下”而时距缩短，说明不是降雨强度或降雨历时变化导致，而是流域汇流、蓄滞条件改变。运用水文规律：湿地具有蓄水、滞洪、延缓径流汇入河道的作用；若上游湿地大量破坏，流域调蓄能力下降，雨水更快转化为河流径流，洪峰更早到达，所以雨量高峰与流量高峰间的时距缩短。答案为：上游湿地大量破坏。

再推理：题目说明是在相同降雨状态下，若雨量高峰和流量高峰之间的时距缩短，则原因不应是降雨本身变化，而应是流域调蓄、滞洪能力下降。湿地具有涵养水源、蓄水滞洪、延缓地表径流汇入河道的作用。若上游湿地大量破坏，雨水会更快形成径流并汇入河流，使洪峰提前到来，因此时距缩短。
